Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium website customization workflow photograph, square source intended for a circular crop
Primary request: A clear overhead documentary photograph of a small-batch product customization briefing. Two adult hands review generic outline sketches for a plain T-shirt, a cap, and a canvas tote, with a neutral canvas tote and a plain cap partially visible near the center. The paper is present as a work surface, but all writing and sketch labels are indistinct and unreadable.
Scene/backdrop: A calm product workshop design table with warm ivory paper, a few restrained navy and slate fabric swatches, and natural tactile surfaces.
Subject: The central hands, three simple product outline drawings, and partial tote and cap samples, all composed as one coherent briefing moment.
Style/medium: Premium realistic documentary product photography, natural texture, understated and credible.
Composition/framing: Native square overhead photo. Keep all essential hands, sketches and product cues within the central 70% of the square so the image reads clearly when cropped into a 310px circle. Balanced breathing room around the center; corners may be expendable. One clear action, not a collage.
Lighting/mood: Soft neutral daylight, gentle shadows, calm collaborative focus.
Color palette: Ivory, natural canvas, navy, slate, subdued warm wood.
Materials/textures: Matte paper, cotton fabric swatches, natural canvas, subtle tabletop grain.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: No logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no legible text. Do not make this apparel-only: the sketch cues include a T-shirt, cap and tote. High-resolution square photograph.
Avoid: Collages, split panels, graphic overlays, fake writing, clutter, exaggerated hands, extra people, overly staged stock-photo gestures.
